csv_scope_of_work: The City of Quincy, acting on behalf of the Planning Board, is soliciting proposals for Consultant Review Services to be provided on an on-call basis. The City of Quincy is seeking plan review services in each of the following areas: Definitive Subdivisions Plan Review. Site Plan Reviews and Site Plan/Special Permit Reviews pursuant to M.G.L. C. 40A, S.9 and the City of Quincy Zoning Ordinances. Certificates of Consistency pursuant to the City of Quincy Zoning Ordinances Sections 17.8.3, 17.9.3.3 and 17.10. Notices of Intent under the Wetlands Protection Act. Construction Phase Oversight

title: On-call Consultant Review Services - Quincy
short_description: On-call multidisciplinary plan review and construction oversight services for Quincy planning approvals.
project_scope: On-call consultant review services for the City of Quincy Planning Board, including review of definitive subdivision plans, site plan reviews, site plan/special permit reviews under M.G.L. c. 40A §9 and local zoning ordinances, certificates of consistency under zoning ordinance sections 17.8.3, 17.9.3.3 and 17.10, notices of intent under the Wetlands Protection Act, and construction phase oversight. No specific building, bridge, span, or floor area is defined because this is an on-call framework-type review assignment.
services: Consultant review services on an on-call basis in architecture, civil engineering, inspection services, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering; plan review and construction phase oversight.
relevance_explanation:
- This is an on-call consultant review/framework-style service rather than a defined design project.
- Scope focuses on plan review, permitting support, and oversight, not structural design of a specific structure.
- Includes general building and planning-board review tasks with broad multidisciplinary coverage.
- No identifiable bridge, long-span roof, stadium, special structure, or complex building opportunity.
- Framework agreements without technical specification are explicitly low priority for sbp.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated. The notice is for on-call review services across multiple potential private or public development submissions, with no defined project size, building area, or construction volume; therefore no realistic project-specific construction cost estimate is possible.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated. This is an on-call review services procurement, potentially with one or more contracts and a 12-month base period plus 24-month renewal option, but without contract value, hourly rates, or expected workload.
references_qualifications: Bidders are sought for consultant review services in architecture, civil engineering, inspection, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and structural engineering. No specific minimum reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the provided text.
contracting_authority: City of Quincy, acting on behalf of the Planning Board, Quincy, MA, USA. Contact: Kathryn R Logan. Phone: 617-376-1060. Fax: 617-376-1074. Email: klogan@quincyma.gov. Website: https://www.quincyma.gov/bid_detail_T2_R1312.php
notes: Project number: 865700; solicitation/project reference PD888-130062; ProjectID 1009140; DR# 202600224746. Questions deadline: 06/12/2026 12:00 PM EDT. One or more contracts may be awarded. Contract duration indicated as renewable, with 12-month base period and 24-month renewal option. Although structural engineering is listed, the procurement is primarily for municipal review services rather than project-specific design.
